items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 1:22PM EST until November 15 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 25 kt and seas 4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...From 1 AM Saturday to 1 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A cold front will move through tonight
which will lead to a round of elevated winds and seas tonight
through Saturday evening.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
